prompt:
NEWLY DRAWN 2D game animation. Character identity locked to reference model sheet: red ponytail and eyes, same ornate black/red coat with silver chains and red jewels, black gloves/boots, same human proportions, no weapons. Crisp consistent anime illustration, not chibi. EXACT LEFT-FACING PROFILE in every cell. Camera never rotates; nose points left; show the same near side in every frame.
OUTPUT EXACTLY 15 isolated complete full-body sprites in an EXACT grid of FIVE columns and THREE rows, landscape 1536x1024. Five characters in each row, three rows total. Strict equal cells, generous transparent margins; no touching/crossing neighboring cells. TRUE TRANSPARENT RGBA; absolutely no background/color haze/glow/ground/shadows/checkerboard/text/grid marks or numbers. Constant character scale and camera, local root x and planted foot baseline identical in all cells. No interpolation, no reusing sparse eight-frame poses: draw fifteen distinct finely spaced consecutive poses.
This is part 1 of four parts making 60 frames, in left-to-right top-to-bottom order. Draw only the designated 15-frame stage, NOT a full cycle compressed into fifteen. FIRST QUARTER frames00-14 of ONE looping low fast SPRINT/DASH two-step cycle. Start00 in strong forward lean, LEFT foot ahead bracing on forefoot, RIGHT leg extended back, elbows bent close to torso. Maintain low body posture and flowing coat and ponytail trailing in motion direction. Left leg compresses then pushes forcefully; right knee drives forward. End14 near flight/passing with right knee ahead. No upright walk or stationary attack.


Keep left/right limb identity anatomically clear, coherent hands, knees and ankles. Smooth opposing arm/leg swing. Hair and coat follow a consistent lagging arc and finish at the phase that flows into the first frame. Every frame complete and newly drawn; no abrupt pose, scale or costume changes.
